columns.label: SKU
columns.helpText: Unique product identifier; not editable in bulk

columns.label: Description
columns.helpText: Product description. Supports HTML formatting for listings.

columns.label: Theme template
columns.helpText: The product template suffix in the store’s theme. Leave empty to use its default.

columns.label: Product category
columns.helpText: Shopify taxonomy category ID, for example gid://shopify/TaxonomyCategory/aa-1.

columns.label: Product type
columns.helpText: Master Amazon productType — drives category-specific attribute fields. Per-channel overrides happen in the per-product editor.

columns.label: Vendor
columns.helpText: The vendor shown on this store. This does not change the shared product brand.

columns.label: Tags
columns.helpText: Searchable store tags, up to 255 characters each. Shopify’s tag count depends on the store plan.

columns.label: URL handle
columns.helpText: The product URL handle, using letters, numbers and hyphens.
